entities.name: Louis Buvelot
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abram-Louis "Louis" Buvelot was a Swiss landscape painter who lived 17 years in Brazil, and following 5 years back in Switzerland, stayed 23 years in Australia, where he influenced the Heidelberg School of painters.
